# Components

<!-- Generated by generate-indexes.mjs; edit contracts, then regenerate. -->

- **Button**
  - Description: Invoke one immediate action, or show one on/off choice such as a filter chip, through a native button. The accessible name is the label.
  - Contract: [contract](components/button.md)

- **Data grid**
  - Description: Present one single-select table of records that share the same columns. Arrow keys, J and K, Home, and End move the selection.
  - Contract: [contract](components/data-grid.md)

- **Disclosure**
  - Description: Hide extra content under one heading until the person expands it. It starts collapsed unless the open atom is already true.
  - Contract: [contract](components/disclosure.md)

- **Drawer**
  - Description: Cover the bottom of the current shell with a dialog the person can dismiss. The dialog stays in the tree that mounted it, including a shadow root.
  - Contract: [contract](components/drawer.md)

- **Empty state**
  - Description: Explain why a region has no rows and offer at most one next action.
  - Contract: [contract](components/empty-state.md)

- **Field**
  - Description: Collect one search string, one choice from a known option list, or one number. Search and select expose the label to assistive tech and hide the visible label. The number field shows its label.
  - Contract: [contract](components/field.md)

- **Icon**
  - Description: Draw one named admin glyph in the current text color. Decorative unless the caller passes a label because the icon is the only name.
  - Contract: [contract](components/icon.md)

- **Inspector**
  - Description: Read one value as an expandable tree of objects, arrays, maps, and sets. The caller passes an atom of a value it already has.
  - Contract: [contract](components/inspector.md)

- **Inspector tabs**
  - Description: Switch the four sections of one selected record: Overview, Cause Chain, History, and JSON. A fixed Tabs preset.
  - Contract: [contract](components/inspector-tabs.md)

- **Kbd**
  - Description: Show one keyboard shortcut as keycaps so the person can recognize it beside a control, in a hint, or in help.
  - Contract: [contract](components/kbd.md)

- **Popover**
  - Description: Open a non-modal note anchored to its trigger. Escape or a press outside closes it. The panel stays in the trigger's tree, including a shadow root.
  - Contract: [contract](components/popover.md)

- **Rail graph**
  - Description: Show a cause chain as a commit-style list: one row per record with rails in a left gutter. Color shows cause, selection, and effect. Click a row to select it. Double-click or Shift+Enter re-roots.
  - Contract: [contract](components/rail-graph.md)

- **Split pane**
  - Description: Place two regions side by side and let the person drag or arrow-key a vertical separator. Double-click restores the default ratio.
  - Contract: [contract](components/split-pane.md)

- **Status bar**
  - Description: Pin one line of session status to the bottom of the shell. StatusDot adds a tone-colored mark plus the words that carry the meaning.
  - Contract: [contract](components/status-bar.md)

- **Tabs**
  - Description: Switch one visible section among peer sections. Arrow keys move the selected tab and the selection wraps. The caller renders the selected panel.
  - Contract: [contract](components/tabs.md)

- **Toast**
  - Description: Show one short status with an optional undo action, then dismiss it when the time runs out or the person dismisses it. The node stays in the mounted tree, including a shadow root.
  - Contract: [contract](components/toast.md)

- **Toolbar**
  - Description: Lay out one row of controls at the toolbar height, with groups and a flexible spacer. The row does not wrap.
  - Contract: [contract](components/toolbar.md)
